name: EclipseGradient
description: A raw WebGL eclipse shader: a pure black disk ringed by a slowly turning corona of noise-driven rays, a hot inner glow and an RGB-split chromatic rim, with optional pointer tilt that parallaxes the disk against its corona. Falls back to a CSS disk with a rotating masked conic corona when WebGL is unavailable.
a11yNotes: The canvas (or CSS fallback) is an aria-hidden decorative layer; children render above with light, heavily shadowed text. Pointer tilt is purely cosmetic and needs no interaction. Animation stops off-screen, at speed 0 (tilt still eases when interactive), and under prefers-reduced-motion (one static frame, tilt disabled). GL resources are deleted on unmount and a lost context switches to the CSS fallback.

propsApi.name: color3
propsApi.description: Chromatic rim color around the disk (hex).

propsApi.name: backgroundColor
propsApi.description: Deep space color behind the eclipse (hex).

propsApi.name: rayIntensity
propsApi.description: Length and brightness of the corona rays (0–2).

propsApi.name: interactive
propsApi.description: Tilt the disk and corona toward the pointer.

propsApi.name: height
propsApi.description: Height of the background in px.

propsApi.name: children
propsApi.description: Content rendered centered on top; defaults to a heading and subline.
